propositions: CLI rebar transition close --ref HEAD with out-of-worktree REBAR_TRACKER_DIR falsely reports no commit references the ticket because code_root is derived from tracker parent instead of current code worktree

close_precheck._completion_precheck reads ticket state correctly from relocated tracker but uses os.path.dirname(tracker) for git -C and gate config, causing git log and gate evaluation to scan wrong repository
The defect causes either false missing-commit rejection or silent unsigned close depending on whether gate config exists in tracker parent

Code root must be resolved through config.repo_root(repo_root) for both commit evidence scanning and completion-gate configuration while tracker reads remain independent via config.tracker_dir(repo_root)
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit failures must remain unchanged after repair
